config.notes: Yoobee (yoobee.ac.nz) course pages, one per programme; each names the NZQA award it leads to ("you will receive the New Zealand Diploma in ... (Level N)"), which is how catalogue courses (NZQA titles) were bound to the branded pages. Header: "Level N NZQA 40 weeks" or "Level 7 3 years". Intakes: "Course Start Dates" block with campus tabs (Online / Wellington / Auckland / Christchurch) and dated starts. Fee: "International students Tuition Fees: $27,300 /year (NZD)" (multi-year programmes, per year) or "$27,300 (NZD)" for one-year programmes (34-45 weeks, taken as the annual fee); resource/enrolment fees left out. Sub-year programmes (16-19 weeks) print one total: fee excluded for those courses. Delivery from the start-date campuses (Online Campus only = online). IELTS overall from the entry requirements. Many catalogue courses (beauty, hairdressing, barbering, tourism, hospitality, nursing, health) belong to sister schools of the same NZQA provider on other websites and have no Yoobee page.
